interface.shortDescription: Read, sort and answer your email
interface.longDescription: Work with your mailbox at GMX, WEB.DE, Yahoo, AOL, iCloud, IONOS, Bluewin, Infomaniak, Hostpoint or any other provider. Get a short briefing of what came in, see who is waiting for your reply and who has not answered you, follow up on open quotes and invoices, find facts in old mail, and let the assistant write drafts. Mail is only sent when you ask, and sending can require your approval through a link.
